Remediations.Description: With Game Pass, you can play more great games anytime.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
JOIN A COMMUNITY OF 30 MILLION PLAYERS! Get ready for a high-speed trip across the USA and enjoy one of the most complete open-world action driving experiences ever created. With access to free content, new game modes, tracks, vehicles, events, and more added every season, The Crew® 2 has all you need for an unforgettable ride.

Take on the American motorsports scene, discover exhilarating landscapes and pick your favorite vehicles among hundreds. Experience the thrill and excitement of competing across the USA as you test your skills in a wide range of disciplines. Record every heart-pounding moment and share them with the push of a button - fame is yours to take! Play with up to seven friends online.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: JOIN A COMMUNITY OF 30 MILLION PLAYERS! Take on the American motorsports scene as you explore and dominate the land, air, and sea across the USA. Pick your favorite vehicles and test your skills in a wide range of driving disciplines.
